Tests fd_circq push and pop behavior, random use, and size bounds.

# Purpose
This file is a C test program for the `fd_circq` circular queue API. It creates queue instances with `fd_circq_new` and `fd_circq_join`, then checks push and pop behavior with fixed data and random data. The [`test_simple1`](<#test_simple1>), [`test_simple2`](<#test_simple2>), and [`test_simple3`](<#test_simple3>) functions exercise queue allocation, message storage, message order, empty-queue handling, and repeated use under load. The [`test_bounds`](<#test_bounds>) function checks that `fd_circq_push_back` accepts or rejects writes based on the available space, and [`main`](<#main>) runs all tests and reports success with `FD_LOG_NOTICE`.
